data.title: Honor .sealignore in rendered diff payloads
data.description: Filters ignored git-diff sections and ignored-file thread metadata before formatting. Includes a 2.1 MB regression across text, JSON, and pretty output. Full tests pass; full check is blocked only by four baseline rustc 1.97 clippy diagnostics reproduced in default.

data.body: INFO: filter_diff duplicates the section-splitting byte-offset loop from git_diff_changed_paths (scm/mod.rs:80). Consider extracting a shared 'for each diff --git section' iterator both can consume, so future fixes (e.g. CRLF offset handling) only need to touch one place. Non-blocking.

data.reason: Diff payload now filtered independently from changed-file metadata; consistent with build_file_diffs. Fails closed. Regression covers text/JSON/pretty + 2.1MB payload; both new tests pass. Clippy warnings are pre-existing baseline in ids.rs/log.rs, not this change.

data.body: Agreed this is a useful cleanup. Keeping the loop mirrored in this focused bug fix preserves identical path parsing with changed_files; a shared section iterator can be extracted separately without expanding the payload-leak patch.

data.reason: Acknowledged as non-blocking follow-up; current fix intentionally mirrors the established parser.
